learning_outcomes.text: Apply the terminology of the subject and discuss tasks with colleagues.
Independently select, dimension, and integrate the necessary machine elements for a design into an overall design.

Apply calculation and design methods for the treated machine elements at an engineering level and meaningfully link them with knowledge of statics, strength of materials, materials science, and design theory.
Transfer the acquired knowledge to other machine elements.

syllabus_topics: Shaft-hub connections (Key connections, splined shafts, cylindrical and conical press fits, clamping elements, circlips)
Plain Bearings (Plastic plain bearings, composite plain bearings)
Rolling Bearings (Life calculation, design of bearing and bearing seat)
Guides (Plain and rolling element linear guides)
Spur Gear Drives (Geometry, rough design, types of damage)
Belt Drives (Flat, V-belt, and timing belts)
assessment_rules: The assessment consists of a 90-minute written exam. Students can earn bonus points by completing and presenting tasks during the course. These bonus points, up to a maximum of 10 percent of the points achievable in the exam, are added to the exam score. There is no entitlement to the bonus system being offered in a given semester.
